newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel set to climb towards 129.38.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel set to climb towards 129.38.

text.p: June notionnel futures traded on MATIF are set to break higher and beat a path towards 129.38 on Thursday, technical analysts said.
"The market is going to trade back up," said Stavros Loizou, manager of strategic trading group at Fuji Bank in London.

"The old high at 128.88 has held us back this morning but if we can break above that the market looks very constructive. We should test 129.06 minimum, and will probably test the high again at 129.38."
At 0816 GMT, June notionnel futures were at 128.82, up 22 basis points from Wednesday's close.
The market formed a high at 129.38 on April 17, while 129.06 is an old support level from before March 17 when the market declined.
To the downside, Loizou said the bias was that the market had put in a short-term base and he would be a seller if 128.24 broke.
On daily charts that was the low on April 21, just above the 128.20 base on April 22 from where the conract has bounced up.
Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London, placed initial support around the lows for this session at 128.56.
"Support is at 128.50 and for now we are consolidating," he said.
Below there, Branigan also saw support at 128.20, ahead of 128.04. Daily charts show that level was the low on April 14.
"If we go through 128.20, then you could argue we have broken the neckline of a head and shoulders which would take us down to 127.10," Loizou said. "But I favour the upside."
At the short end, June Pibor futures were at 96.41, up three basis points on the day.
